As we talk about HUMONGOUS Chinese loans gobbled up by 's government over the last 6 years or so, are we aware of the BALLOONING DEBT'S impact on DEVOLUTION, HEALTHCARE (#PumwaniHospital), FOOD SECURITY and BASIC SERVICES to the common mwananchi? A thread!

Simply put Jubilee more than doubled the DEBT borrowed in your name by Jomo, Moi & Kibaki over 49 yrs in just 5 yrs! Who will pay the debt in a POOR country like Kenya? Are we all going to be enslaved by the Chinese once we default on their loans?

In the FY 18/19 alone, CS Rotich budgeted a whooping Sh870.62 B to pay off maturing debt & interest. Kenya’s nearly half of the Sh1.743 trillion, which the Treasury targets to collect from taxpayers, will be spent on debt repayments. 1 in every 2 Shillings will pay debt

The character of the debt we have is not good. All our debts were concessional, bilateral & unilateral. If we had borrowed the SGR money from the World Bank, we wouldn't have paid for it till 10 years later and then paid it for 30 years thereafter at about half the interest rate.

At some point, we had the best local debt market in Africa. We have to borrow more to keep afloat. We are on a treadmill. When the Chinese debt principal is going to come knocking, we won't be able to pay it through SGR revenues but through borrowing more.

As we struggle to pay high-interest rates on loans (top priority), transfer to Counties will dip (in July, 0 transfer went to counties). Devolution is critical to people’s livelihoods & wellbeing including health, agriculture, sanitation, etc. Debt's threat to DEVOLUTION is real
